director.text: Hello Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi shapes ka perimeter nikaalenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare poori pitch ghoomo aur wapas wahin aa jao. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai.
theek hai

Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Pehle 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm. Teeno ko ek ke baad ek jodte jao. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Theek hai, main yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Socho is triangle ka kinaara ek dhaage se bana hai. Ek kone se dhaaga khol ke seedha kar do: 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm, sab ek line mein. Us seedhi line ki poori lambai hi parimap hai. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Aao, isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Ab ek khet socho, kone P, Q, R, S, T. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise-jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh jod adhoora. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yeh hissa saaf hua?

seams.form: Aao, isko ek naye dhang se dekhein.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai haan
Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

P se shuru karo aur PQ, QR, RS, ST, TP bolte jao. TP ke baad tum wapas P par ho. 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m bhujaon wale khet PQRST ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: 15 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai: 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 5 cm
5 cm sahi nahi hai. Har bhuja par 5 cm likha hua socho. Ab chhah baar 5 cm jodo. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi
Is sawaal ka jawab 30 cm hai, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya
5 cm ko ek-ek karke chhah baar jodo: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, toh 30 cm. Yahan tak saaf hai?
phir bhi samajh nahi aaya

Shahad ke chhatte ka ek khaana dekho: uski chhah bhujayein hoti hain, sab ek jaisi. Yahan ek bhuja par 5 cm likha hai, toh baaki paanch bhi 5 cm ki hain. Parimap ke liye chhahon bhujayein ginni hain, sirf likhi hui nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: upar 6, bagal ki bhuja 4, neeche 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 24 cm

24 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Kinaare par dhaaga lapeto, phir kholke scale par rakho: woh lambai parimap hai, cm mein. Andar tiles bichhao toh woh area hai. Parimap mein chaaron bhujayein jodte hain, guna nahi. Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?

Kyari ki teen bhujayein hain, 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m. Baad poore kinaare par lagegi, toh dekhna hai kitni lambi. Yahan tak theek hai?
phir bhi samajh nahi aaya

Socho tum kyari ke ek kone par khade ho. 7 m chalo, mudo, 9 m chalo, mudo, phir 12 m chal ke wahin pahunch jao. Baad utni hi lambi chahiye jitna tum chale, toh wahi doori nikalni hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya
Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai.
haan samajh gayi

director.text: 26 metres
Sahi jawab, kyunki chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

40 cm nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Guna andar ki jagah ginta hai, kinaara nahi. Do baar 10, do baar 4. 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

Haan, sahi hai: parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai.
